title: Bunker: Browser-based Party Game
summary: A light, fast browser-based party game where each player gets a survival character with hidden attributes (profession, health, age, etc.). Every round introduces a bunker event, and players must reveal cards and argue why they deserve a place in the bunker to survive.
details: No database: All rooms live in memory
Zero auth: Just enter a name and play

title: Resume Website
summary: A consistently styled, responsive personal resume website built with HTML, CSS (Bootstrap), and JavaScript. It uses a JSON-driven approach for easy content management.
